title: Edit a picture, keep the rest
description: Change a picture with words (FLUX.2 Klein 9B), and everything you did not ask to change stays exactly as it was: only the areas the edit really changed are kept, the rest is the original, pixel for pixel. A second preview shows what changed.

app.title: Edit, keep the rest
